desc_original: Thailand's auto exports in October fell by 34% year-on-year to 54,503 due to a drop in internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicle production, following massive floods in eastern provinces and Bangkok, says the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI).

title: AI cyber-attacks raise security concerns
desc: Cyber-attacks powered by artificial intelligence (AI) are accelerating at machine speed, creating an urgent security challenge for organisations in Thailand.

summary_cn: 人工智能驱动的网络攻击以机器速度加速蔓延，对泰国各类组织构成紧迫的安全挑战，需要立即重视防护措施。
desc_original: Cyber-attacks powered by artificial intelligence (AI) are accelerating at machine speed, creating an urgent security challenge for organisations in Thailand.

title: BoT eager to shrink informal economy
desc: The Bank of Thailand is stepping up efforts to bring informal businesses and workers into the formal economy, aiming to unlock productivity gains, widen access to finance and strengthen long-term household financial security.
title_cn: 泰国央行加快推进非正式经济正规化
summary_cn: 泰国央行(BoT)加紧努力将非正式企业和劳动力纳入正规经济体系，旨在释放生产力潜能、扩大融资渠道获取、强化家庭长期财务安全。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand is stepping up efforts to bring informal businesses and workers into the formal economy, aiming to unlock productivity gains, widen access to finance and strengthen long-term household financial security.

title: High aviation costs limit expansion during peak season
desc: Busier air traffic and rising traveller numbers during the high season have made Thailand's aviation sector more vibrant in the final quarter.
title_cn: 航空成本高企 旺季扩张受限
summary_cn: 虽然高峰期航班运量和游客数量增加推动泰国航空业四季度更显活跃，但高昂的航空成本成为扩张的主要障碍。旺季业务繁忙的同时，高成本压力制约了行业进一步的发展空间。
desc_original: Busier air traffic and rising traveller numbers during the high season have made Thailand's aviation sector more vibrant in the final quarter.

title: AI bubble fears fuel hopes of gold revival
desc: Concerns over a potential bubble in artificial intelligence (AI) stocks could provide another boost for gold prices as investors reassess risk exposure and seek to diversify their portfolios, although an initial market sell-off could also trigger temporary pressure on bullion, says Hua Seng Heng.
title_cn: AI泡沫风险升温 黄金投资重获青睐
summary_cn: 对人工智能股票泡沫的担忧促使投资者重新评估风险敞口，增加黄金等避险资产配置以实现投资组合多元化。金价因此可能上升，但初期市场可能出现抛售，造成短期压力。
desc_original: Concerns over a potential bubble in artificial intelligence (AI) stocks could provide another boost for gold prices as investors reassess risk exposure and seek to diversify their portfolios, although an initial market sell-off could also trigger temporary pressure on bullion, says Hua Seng Heng.

title: NACC eyes wider probe into Phuket coastal plots
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) Region 8 is accelerating its investigation into the acquisition of a land plot allegedly encroaching on Hat Bang Tao, with similar investigations expected to be launched across Phuket.
title_cn: 廉政委扩大调查 普吉邦涛地块涉嫌违规
summary_cn: 国家廉政委（NACC）第8地区加快调查一宗涉嫌侵占邦涛（Bang Tao）海滩的地块收购案。预计将在普吉岛各地启动类似调查，严查沿海地产权属违规问题。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) Region 8 is accelerating its investigation into the acquisition of a land plot allegedly encroaching on Hat Bang Tao, with similar investigations expected to be launched across Phuket.

title: B20bn civil service buyout deferred
desc: The cabinet has deferred approval in principle of a proposed early retirement scheme for civil servants, ordering a further review of its budget impact and long-term effectiveness.
title_cn: 公务员200亿铢提前退休计划遭搁置
summary_cn: 内阁推迟批准拟议的公务员提前退休计划。该计划涉及资金200亿铢，内阁要求进一步审查其对预算的影响和长期有效性，以作出最终决策。
desc_original: The cabinet has deferred approval in principle of a proposed early retirement scheme for civil servants, ordering a further review of its budget impact and long-term effectiveness.

title: Thailand promotes regional airport links
desc: Thailand is promoting its regional airports as gateways to major tourist destinations and expanding direct international links, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said.
title_cn: 泰国推广地区机场 拓展国际航线网络
summary_cn: 泰国副运输部长帕特拉蓬表示，泰国正推广地区机场作为通往主要旅游目的地的枢纽，同时扩展地区机场的直接国际航线。此举将促进地方经济发展，完善旅游基础设施。
desc_original: Thailand is promoting its regional airports as gateways to major tourist destinations and expanding direct international links, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said.

title: Daily rail fare caps extended
desc: The cabinet has approved extending daily flat-fare tickets for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines until the end of 2027 to reduce public transport costs.
title_cn: 曼谷红、紫线日票价格管制延期至2027年底
summary_cn: 泰内阁批准将曼谷红线(Red Line)和紫线(Purple Line)电动轻轨的日票价格管制措施延期至2027年底。此举旨在降低公共交通成本。日票价格固定，对在泰居住的外国人和本地通勤者的日常出行成本有直接影响，是一项重要民生政策。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved extending daily flat-fare tickets for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines until the end of 2027 to reduce public transport costs.

title: Thais seek Shan mining pause
desc: Thailand will ask Myanmar to halt unregulated mining in Shan State for six months so Thailand and China can develop a plan to curb arsenic pollution in rivers, Deputy Prime Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 泰国请缅甸暂停掸邦非法采矿
summary_cn: 泰国副总理颂差南·翁沙瓦表示，泰国将要求缅甸暂停掸邦(Shan State)非法采矿六个月，以便泰国与中国制定计划遏制河流砷污染问题。该议题直接威胁在泰人士的饮水安全和环境质量，属于跨境污染防治的重要事项。
desc_original: Thailand will ask Myanmar to halt unregulated mining in Shan State for six months so Thailand and China can develop a plan to curb arsenic pollution in rivers, Deputy Prime Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat said on Tuesday.

title: Anutin rules out BoT intervention
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has insisted that disagreements over proposed amendments to laws governing the Bank of Thailand (BoT) are an internal matter for the central bank, saying its chairman and governor must work together to resolve the issue without government intervention.
title_cn: 阿努廷排除政府干预央行事务
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·差尼瓦拉库表示，围绕泰国央行(Bank of Thailand)法律修订的分歧属央行内部事务，央行主席和行长应独立协调解决，不需政府干预。这一表态反映了政府对央行独立性的尊重和经济金融治理的重要决定。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has insisted that disagreements over proposed amendments to laws governing the Bank of Thailand (BoT) are an internal matter for the central bank, saying its chairman and governor must work together to resolve the issue without government intervention.

title: Court hears challenge to senators' eligibility
desc: The Supreme Court's Election Cases Division heard four witnesses on Tuesday in a case brought by a reserve senator who alleges that two sitting senators applied under the wrong occupational groups.
title_cn: 最高法院审理参议员资格诉讼
summary_cn: 泰国最高法院选举案件部门周二召开庭审，审理由替补参议员提出的投诉。投诉者指控两名现任参议员以错误的职业分类申请参议员资格。这是泰国政治制度和参议院资格认定方面的重要法律纠纷。
desc_original: The Supreme Court's Election Cases Division heard four witnesses on Tuesday in a case brought by a reserve senator who alleges that two sitting senators applied under the wrong occupational groups.

title: Chud Thai bids for Unesco listing
desc: Thailand is hoping to secure international recognition for "Chud Thai", its traditional national dress, as Unesco considers the country's nomination for intangible cultural heritage status on Dec 2.
title_cn: 泰国旗袍申报联合国非遗项目
summary_cn: 泰国争取将传统民族服饰「筑泰」(Chud Thai)列入联合国教科文组织非遗名录，联教组织将于12月2日审议泰国的提名申请。获批将为泰国文化遗产获得国际认可，同时有助于保护和传承这一重要的民族文化符号。
desc_original: Thailand is hoping to secure international recognition for "Chud Thai", its traditional national dress, as Unesco considers the country's nomination for intangible cultural heritage status on Dec 2.

title: Gas carrier hits rocks off Phaluai
desc: Surat Thani: A liquefied gas carrier, the 2,703-gross-tonne Unique 10, has run aground on submerged rocks off Phaluai Island, damaging its hull and allowing seawater to enter its ballast tanks.
title_cn: 液化气运输船「尤尼克10号」(Unique 10)在拍岭岛(Phaluai)外搁浅
summary_cn: 一艘2703吨的液化气运输船在泰国素叻他尼府(Surat Thani)拍岭岛(Phaluai)外触礁搁浅，船体受损，海水进入压舱水舱。
desc_original: Surat Thani: A liquefied gas carrier, the 2,703-gross-tonne Unique 10, has run aground on submerged rocks off Phaluai Island, damaging its hull and allowing seawater to enter its ballast tanks.

title: Farm import rules for Efta, Bhutan OK'd
desc: The cabinet on Tuesday approved in principle draft import rules for farm goods under Thailand's free trade agreements (FTAs) with the European Free Trade Association (Efta) and Bhutan, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.

summary_cn: 泰国内阁于周二原则上批准了与欧洲自由贸易协会(EFTA)和不丹自由贸易协定框架下的农产品进口规则草案，旨在推进双边农业贸易合作。
desc_original: The cabinet on Tuesday approved in principle draft import rules for farm goods under Thailand's free trade agreements (FTAs) with the European Free Trade Association (Efta) and Bhutan, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.

title: Thailand moves closer to free trade with four European nations
desc: Thailand moves closer to free trade with four European nations Legacy Thailand’s Cabinet has approved draft import rules for European dairy products and instant coffee as the country prepares to implement its first free trade agreement with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), targeted for January 1, 2027. The agreement with the EFTA, comprising Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland, is expected to expand market access for Thai agricultural, food and industrial exports. Deputy government spokesperson Lalida Persvivatana announced the Cabinet’s decision today, November 24, saying the new rules would allow certain agricultural imports from EFTA countries to receive tariff exemptions. The draft Commerce Ministry regulations cover three product groups: milk, cream and flavoured milk drinks; skimmed milk powder; and instant coffee. Milk products and skimmed milk powder originating in and shipped directly from any of the four EFTA countries would qualify for the exemptions. desc: American climber ranks Khon Kaen bouldering site among world’s best Legacy An American rock climber has ranked Nam Phong National Park in Khon Kaen as the best bouldering destination in Southeast Asia and among the world’s top 10 , as the park prepares to host an international climbing competition in January 2027. Brad Ausink, 33, praised the park’s sandstone formations for their quality, variety and suitability for climbers of different abilities. Speaking today, November 24, Ausink said the rocks were less sharp and brittle than those at other climbing destinations. Their sandpaper-like surfaces provide a firm grip, even in hot weather or when climbers’ hands become sweaty. He said the experience was similar to climbing on artificial walls in a gym, making the site suitable for beginners trying natural rock for the first time as well as experienced climbers seeking more challenging routes. title: More than 100 songwriters challenge 1.59 billion baht rights sale of RS Group
desc: More than 100 songwriters challenge 1.59 billion baht rights sale of RS Group Legacy More than 100 songwriters, singers and music producers are demanding unpaid royalties from RS Group , accusing the record label of selling the rights to their lyrics and melodies for up to 1.59 billion baht without sharing the proceeds. The complaint was presented through lawyer Decha Kittiwittayanan and is backed by former RS artists, led by singer-songwriter Ittiphon Saneewong Na Ayutthaya, better known as Vespa from the duo STER. Vespa said the artists had licensed their songs to RS, formerly known as RS Promotion, for commercial use rather than selling the copyrights outright. He argued that the original contracts entitled songwriters to a percentage of revenue from sales of tapes, CDs, ringtones and other distribution channels. According to Vespa, some songwriters received these payments for years before they stopped, despite their songs continuing to generate revenue through digital platforms. Some members of the group said they had not received any royalties since 2001. title: How to choose a superyacht charter in Phuket? Seven compared
desc: How to choose a superyacht charter in Phuket? Seven compared Legacy Planning a Phuket superyacht charter for a winter week on the Andaman Sea means weighing more than the weekly rate. Boatcrowd’s seven picks carry rates from US$115,000 to US$380,000 a week, and once the bill is split between 10 or 12 guests, the lowest rate isn’t always the cheapest per head. Yacht charter marketplace Boatcrowd , which lists crewed yachts in over 70 countries, has picked seven superyachts to charter in Phuket this winter. Weekly rates run from US$115,000 to US$380,000. Boatcrowd’s fleet data from November 23 puts those rates at 2.4 to 8 times the median for a crewed yacht based on the island. Across 29 priced crewed yachts in Phuket, the median weekly rate starts at about US$47,400. The middle half of the fleet starts at roughly US$27,000 to US$76,000. Among yachts over 30 metres the median is US$110,000 a week, and all seven sit above it. At the top end, TREEHOUSE starts at about 27 times the cheapest crewed yacht on the island, which is US$14,214 a week.
